title: Ruling on Entergy Louisiana, LLC's Motion for Stay Issued by Chief ALJ Melanie Verzwyvelt

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                    ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS DIVISION


                                 DOCKET NUMBER U-37882


                         ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC, EX PARTE


        In re:   Application for certification of generation and transmission resources
                                        and for other relief



          RULING ON ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC’S MOTION FOR STAY


       On August 11, 2026, Entergy Louisiana, LLC (“ELL” or “the Company”) ﬁled a Motion


for Stay Pending Immediate Review by Commission Pursuant to Rule 5 7 (“Motion for Stay”) in

                                                                                        administrative
response to the Louisiana Public Service Commission (“LPSC” or “Commission”)


law judge’s (“ALJ’s”) August 6, 2026 Ruling on Motion for Access to            “Attorneys' Eyes Only”


Information (“AEO Ruling”).

       HAVING CONSIDERED the Motion for Stay, the ALJ ﬁnds good cause to stay the AEO


Ruling pending Commission review in accordance with Rule 57(4) of the Commission’s Rules of

Practice and Procedure. Accordingly,


       PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the Motion for Stay is granted.


       Baton Rouge, Louisiana, this    12"‘ day of August, 2026.




                                                                   Chief   Administrati/e   Law Judge
